subject.title: Feature: config-level default task notify policy

question: What public config shape should OpenClaw support for default task notify policy across ACP, subagent, Task Flow, cron, CLI, and media task runtimes?
rationale: The requested fix adds a user-visible config/default surface and can change channel message volume, so automation should not choose global versus per-runtime semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Per-runtime task defaults
options.body: Add a narrow `agents.defaults.tasks.notifyPolicy` map keyed by runtime, preserve unset current behavior, and keep explicit task or flow policies authoritative.

options.title: Single global task default
options.body: Add one default notify policy for all deliverable task records, accepting a simpler config shape with higher risk of surprising ACP/subagent versus cron/CLI/media behavior differences.

options.title: No config surface
options.body: Keep the per-task CLI override and solve only narrower channel/runtime issues such as Discord visibility or Telegram ACP coalescing.

recommendation.title: Per-runtime task defaults
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `agents.defaults.tasks.notifyPolicy` map keyed by runtime, preserve unset current behavior, and keep explicit task or flow policies authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest recent history across the config, docs, ACP, and task surfaces that would need to move together.
